pokedexEntries.di: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

pokedexEntries.prl: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.

pokedexEntries.pt: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

pokedexEntries.bw: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.

pokedexEntries.x: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

pokedexEntries.or: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

pokedexEntries.y: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

pokedexEntries.as: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

pokedexEntries.bd: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat its prey.

pokedexEntries.shp: Using its tentacles to hang from branches, it looks like a plant when it is not moving. It awaits prey with its mouth wide open.

pokedexEntries.la: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.
